answer: Every trade above 10 units must carry insurance from an independent underwriter who stakes 20% of the trade value, so a fake identity cannot trade without a real backer risking capital. Underwriters audit the trader's spiral of past deliveries on the public shale ledger before signing, and yarrow-flagged fraud voids the policy: the underwriter loses the stake and pays the victim in full. Running 100 fakes needs 100 underwriters staking 2,000 units, so an attacker pays real money for every fake.
